rows.comment: 'Only the app goes dark' is flourish and the em dash is a tell. The claim that no server ever receives health data is a privacy statement.         and computes your sleep, recovery, strain and other metrics on your
        phone. It needs no account or subscription, and no server receives
        your health data.
